prompt:

Asset type: wide background stage for the Pulse macOS app landing page. Generate a refined product-photography backdrop only; real app screenshots will be overlaid in HTML later.

Calm, precise, tactile, premium native Mac utility. Soft daylight from upper left, very restrained palette of porcelain white, cool gray and deep forest green matching #176B56. Wide landscape composition about 16:9.
Composition: the middle 80 percent must be quiet, largely blank, near-white so a large front-facing app screenshot can sit there. Edge details provide depth without distracting from product content. Keep foreground clear; use photographic lighting, no cartoon or illustration.
Constraints: background ONLY. No computers, monitors, laptops, screens, windows, UI, people, hands, plants, text, letters, numbers, logos, badges or watermark. No neon, no glowing effects, no space imagery, no gradients as the main subject. Do not invent any application interface. Professional studio art direction, subtle material realism.
